text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam

Accounts and roles
Sign in as a Mentor, Learner or both

Matching and collaboration
Rank mentors, review requests and track progress

Participation and completion
Credits, badges, feedback and a certificate

Local operation
SQLite database and local media storage

Access and uploads
Authentication and participant access checks
Files up to 10 MB with an extension allowlist

Validation and traceability
53 passing tests and a credit ledger

Credit rules in current code: +50 starting credits, -10 for a standard request, -15 total for priority, +10 to mentor per completed session, request fee refunded on rejection/cancellation. Badge thresholds: First Steps one completed mentorship, Committed Mentor two completed as mentor, Rising Star skill_score >=8.0, Top Rated average >=4.5 with at least one review, Helpful Hand at least two resources. Leaderboard = skill_score*10 + credit_balance*0.5 + badge_count*15. Extension allowlist: .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .txt, .docx and .doc, limit 10 MiB. Development settings and demo switching require hardening before production.

text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam
Django templates, Bootstrap 5.3.3 and custom CSS
Django authentication, ORM, views and Python services
SQLite database and local files for uploaded resources

Single Django project, not microservices. User authentication uses Django auth, extended by Profile and RoleAssignment. Credit is a wallet model, not an authentication model. Profile has a many-to-many relationship with Skill. Mentorship references two Users and one Progress record, with related Session, Milestone, Resource and DiscussionPost records. Gamification owns Credit, CreditTransaction, Feedback, Badge, UserBadge and LeaderboardEntry. Notification belongs to User. Services run synchronously in HTTP handlers. No Celery, Redis, payment gateway, video API or calendar sync exists. External meeting URLs support session records.

text:
Live demo uses fictional seeded accounts. Active pair: Sarah Connor and Alex Rivera. Progress = 70*(2/3 completed milestones) + 30*(1/2 completed sessions) =61.7%. Workspace rounds this to 62% in its display. The README and old presentation say 67%, which does not match the implemented weighted formula. Completed pair: Marcus Vance and Priya Sharma, 100% and certificate. Jordan Lee has a priority pending request to Sarah Connor costing 15 credits. Setup: pip install -r requirements.txt, python manage.py migrate, python manage.py seed_demo_data, python manage.py runserver. Windows debug.bat/run_demo.bat automate setup. Seeder rebuilds demo data. Tests: python manage.py test --noinput, 53 passed on 12 October 2026. Per-app counts: accounts12, matching10, mentorship7, gamification18, notifications6. Credit/refund and session rewards include duplicate guards but lack atomic database transactions. Marking a mentorship COMPLETED forces 100% regardless of checklist completion, so certificates indicate workflow completion rather than independently assessed mastery.
